scientific_integrity: An explicit analytical proof and reproducible standard-library checks are provided. The nonreal-sketch phenomenon itself is prior knowledge. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats exactly two real trial vectors, codimension-one unweighted coordinate observation, symmetric positive definite matrices and exact arithmetic. It does not claim randomized-sketch guarantees, general-dimensional sharpness, iteration convergence, or floating-point certification. Historical equivalents may exist.
title: Sharp angular envelope for nonreal sketched Ritz values under codimension-one coordinate sampling
